# PiTTy v0.6.65

- **Automatic command discovery:** The slash menu synchronizes Pi extension commands, prompt templates, and skills every 30 seconds while open. It also updates at startup and on tab switches without restarting PiTTy. Separate tabs retain their own command lists.
- **Better search:** Bare `/` shows common commands first. Search command names, name segments, and descriptions. Up to 24 results are selectable with the scrollable suggestion list.
- **Fresh `/commands`:** Run `/commands` or `/commands search` to refresh immediately and inspect available commands. `/skills` opens instantly from cache while refreshing in the background.
- **Low overhead:** Single-flight fetch, 30-second cache, no polling without the slash menu, and preservation of the last known list if Pi is busy.

Only commands implemented by PiTTy or exposed by Pi's live RPC are suggested. Commands available solely in Pi's native terminal still require Pi support.

Upgrade with `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.65`. The staged update activates on the next launch without stopping active workers.
